entry.title: Alternatives to the UK government’s social media ban
entry.content: The UK government wants to ban social media for under-16s. The goal is reasonable, but there are more effective alternatives that don't require sacrificing privacy and anonymity for the rest of the population. | Read full post >>

entry.title: The UK government is quietly eroding online anonymity
entry.content: The Online Safety Act brought age checks to websites. Now the government wants them built into your devices – removing anonymity that protects whistleblowers, dissidents, and honest personal writing. | Read full post >>

entry.title: Google's AI push could break the information economy
entry.content: If Google's new AI features stop traffic flowing to websites, fewer people will bother running them. That could disrupt the entire online information economy – and deprive AI models of the data they use to learn. | Read full post >>
